embeds.title: Day 5 shipped — palette is now the keyboard-only path
embeds.description: Hit Ctrl+K, type `dis`, Tab → `dispatch `, Tab → `dispatch E1 `, Tab → `dispatch E1 i_42`, Enter. Every verb declares typed slots; the palette only suggests **available** units to dispatch, only **active** incidents as targets, only **not-available** units to recall. Resolved incidents never appear. Tab is the keyboard.

fields.name: Build
fields.value: tsc clean · 45/45 tests · vite 13s · 485 KB gz

fields.name: Verb registry (src/sim/verbs.ts)
fields.value: Typed slots: `unit` / `incident` / `literal` / `speed` / `kind`. Each unit/incident slot can declare a `filter` predicate that prunes irrelevant candidates from suggestions before they're shown.

fields.name: Palette rewrite
fields.value: Dropped cmdk (its filter fought slot-aware suggestions). Plain React + registry. Slot pill row appears once verb is identified — filled / active / empty pills colour-coded. Suggestion rows show display + trailing context (unit status, incident type).

fields.name: Keyboard
fields.value: ↑↓ navigate · Tab apply · Enter execute · Esc close. Auto-dismiss on successful execute (350ms grace).

fields.name: Tests
fields.value: **45/45 pass.** Verbs (23 new): parser corner cases (empty / partial / trailing-space / mid-arg), suggestForInput filtering by state AND partial prefix, applySuggestion trailing-space logic, executeInput happy paths + missing-slot rejection.

fields.name: Day 6 next
fields.value: Tier 1 fully playable. First real shift YAML loaded by the validator from Day 1, spawn timeline driving incidents into the queue at scheduled game-min, win/loss summary on shift end.
